visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a blue screen featuring yellow Chinese text about toilet habits. It transitions to a creative installation of a toilet made from white neon light tubes and filled with numerous small paper slips. A person in a brown shirt is shown reaching into the light-sculpture to grab a slip. (2) Three young people, one male and two females, are seen running energetically down a narrow alleyway at night. They run towards an indoor space decorated with blue curtains and large, colorful inflatable figures with googly eyes. (3) A series of directional signs appear, one reading 'This is a Window' and another pointing to an 'Interesting Entrance'. A person wearing white trousers is seen jumping through a wooden window frame directly onto a large bed in a room with warm, low lighting. (4) A woman in a maroon hoodie lies on a bed while a projected image of a person is cast over her. Another scene shows a person looking intensely into a circular mirror in a room with a desk and various objects. (5) A close-up of a sign for a 'Hand Speed Challenge' is shown. People are seen clapping their hands very rapidly in a dimly lit, red-toned corridor. (6) A woman is seen lying on a bed covered with a plastic sheet labeled 'This is a Bed'. (7) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt and black vest, stands on a small stage with a red curtain background, holding a microphone as if performing stand-up comedy. (8) A woman sits against a wall where a large projection of a hand is pointing directly at her head. (9) A person has their head inside a glowing purple box labeled 'Decibel Measuring Box'. The lighting shifts to neon blue and pink. (10) The three main characters are framed within a window structure, posing playfully. (11) A red LED scrolling sign displays text. The scene transitions to a room with a green desk lamp where two people are interacting. (12) A person is shown writing in a journal under warm lighting. Another shot shows a plastic horse figurine on a board game-like surface. (13) A person is seen from a high angle sitting on a dark balcony decorated with a string of glowing warm light bulbs. (14) Hands are seen drawing characters on a clipboard with a green background. (15) A woman in a dark room spins around while tiny white light dots dance across her body. (16) A woman picks up a vintage-style telephone handset and listens. (17) Two people are seen playfully interacting with a cardboard sign that says 'FREE HUG'. (18) A close-up of a poster titled 'If the City is a Theme Park' features an illustration of a city with a Ferris wheel. (19) A shot of the three main characters waving and smiling reflected in a convex traffic mirror. (20) The three friends stand behind a red-tiled counter labeled 'Ticket Booth', waving and cheering enthusiastically at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a friendly, conversational tone over a quiet background. Subtle shuffling sounds are heard. (2) A clear 'ding' sound effect rings out, marking a transition in the narration as the speaker poses a question. (3) Upbeat, high-tempo acoustic music featuring guitar and light piano begins. The narrator’s voice becomes more rhythmic and excited, adopting a storytelling cadence. (4) A percussive 'thud' sound occurs, synchronized with a visual jump on screen. (5) A rapid series of 'clap' sound effects are introduced, creating a percussive rhythm that matches the visual hand-clapping. (6) A short clip of a laugh track and group cheering is layered into the mix as the music continues at a steady pace. (7) A loud human vocal shout ('Ahhhh!') punctuates the audio, signifying high excitement. (8) The narrator continues with a smoother, slightly more intimate delivery during a montage of scenes. (9) The audio concludes with a energetic swell in the background music and the synchronized voices of three people shouting a cheerful farewell/cheer together.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Showcase -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional trailer for an immersive interactive exhibition titled 'If the City is a Theme Park' created by Surprise Lab. By utilizing a high-energy montage of diverse, whimsical, and emotionally resonant interactive zones—ranging from performance art stages to sensory boxes—the video aims to spark curiosity and invite the audience to experience a playful reinterpretation of urban life. The intent is to drive ticket sales and brand awareness for the limited-time event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the official logo of 'Surprise Lab', explicitly names the exhibition '如果城市，是座樂園', and ends with a 'Ticket Booth' scene and QR code for booking.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a very high density of visual and auditory sound effects common in Taiwanese variety show styles to maintain high viewer engagement.
